ENABLED_DOC: Analyse the playing station and skip to the next one when the topic is detected.
SOURCE_DOC: Use 'My Web Radios', a Volumio playlist or a list typed here.
STATIONS_DOC: Format: Name|URL ; Name|URL ; ... List order is skip order.
DETECT_DOC: Analysis window. If the topic dominates it, the station is changed.
RATIO_DOC: Share of the window that must be on-topic to skip.
CHUNK_DOC: How often the transcript is evaluated.
MINHITS_DOC: Sum of keyword weights needed to flag a block as on-topic.
DEBUG_DOC: Log the result of every block in the Volumio log.
PLAYLIST_DOC: Playlists saved in Volumio (number of web radios in brackets). Only web radios are used, in list order.
PAUSE_DOC: Rest after each block. 0 = continuous. Longer pause = less CPU, slower detection.
SENS_DOC: Low: 180 s, 70 %, 3 pts · Medium: 90 s, 50 %, 2.5 · High: 60 s, 40 %, 2 · Very high: 30 s, 30 %, 1.5. Custom: shows manual settings.
